claim_boundary: This is a complete fixed-n=6 rooted binary-defect computation, not an all-n theorem.
The result concerns the initial rank-four checkpoint reached from mu_d; higher-n return-map inheritance remains open.
The activated witness is generated by one verified preceding macro edge and cannot be forged from endpoint mass bytes.
G4 remains a useful exposure consequence on the unbalanced branch, but it is not sufficient for local escape.

scope.activation_semantics: a replayable preceding macro edge plus its actual parent and fresh packets
scope.checkpoint_semantics: rank-four endpoints of one admissible raw macro block from mu_d
scope.conclusion_semantics: a local raw Type-I/II macro descent into exact P_1/P_2/P_3
scope.entry_section: choose the endpoint-shortest activated block, except the intrinsic predecessor idempotent chooses its p^5 d return block
forbidden_predicate_inputs: raw macro reachability as a state predicate
scope.rooting: the unique binary-kernel collision image is coordinate 0

minimum_entry_word_lemma.proof_basis: the rank-five support omits one coordinate; among three successive omissions at most two can hit the binary kernel pair
minimum_entry_word_lemma.statement: the local endpoint-shortest activated word is p^a d for a in {0,1,2}

predecessor_exception.intrinsic_condition: idempotent with kernel {0,p^-1(0)} and collision image 0

symbolic_classification.remaining_symbolic_gap: replace the exact finite generic-complement exhaustion by a non-enumerative derivation of its local P_<=3 receipt

rooted_idempotent_classification.statement: a rooted binary idempotent is e_m: m maps to 0 and all other image points are fixed; <p,e_m> synchronizes iff gcd(6,m)=1

proof_status.block_obstruction: symbolic: p and d preserve a nontrivial quotient, so their semigroup cannot synchronize
proof_status.generic_complement: exact finite symbolic exhaustion with explicit local P_<=3 receipts; a non-enumerative derivation remains open
proof_status.predecessor_exception: symbolic: the minimum p^2 d endpoint is hostile and the intrinsic p^5 d comb supplies the section

rooted_minimum_entry_trichotomy.statement: the minimum activated entry has a local descent iff d preserves neither nontrivial cyclic block system and d is not the predecessor idempotent

successor_control.intrinsic_condition: idempotent with kernel {0,p(0)} and collision image 0

theorem_boundary.interpretation: Activated one-edge ancestry is a typed Entry witness. The fixed-n=6 section uses only rooted action and entry-corridor data; raw macro closure is not promoted to a state predicate.
